title: FLD02 bounded offline documentary capture transport
description: Input validation grants no device registration, current canonical Person authority, source rights, base revision standing, review, acceptance, financial effect or native qualification. Cross-field equality and replay lineage remain server checks.

FoEnvelope.description: Immutable Project capture attribution; device ownership/current authority and exact source/base revision facts are verified by the server. Canonical UTF-8 JSON is limited to 256 KiB by the service.
